subject: [hw] V30: n2fmt.h is ready for V33/V34; string+heap tables complete
body:
n2shim_string[] and n2shim_heap[] are implemented and pass 277613 host checks (ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan, and a -DV30_NO_VFS build). The formatter/scanner API is frozen in gpu/hwcodec/shim/n2fmt.h (my file; include it, do not copy it).

For V33/V34 (printf/fprintf/log/fscanf forwarding):
  struct n2fmt_args a;
  n2fmt_args_regs(&a, c, first);   // first = index of the first variadic AAPCS slot: printf 1, fprintf 2, sprintf 2, snprintf 3, __android_log_print 3
  int n = n2fmt(c, hostbuf, cap, guest_fmt, &a);   // host buffer, cap includes NUL, returns the untruncated length, -1 on NULL fmt
  // guest va_list (vsnprintf, __*_vprintf_chk, __android_log_vprint):
  n2fmt_args_va(&a, c, guest_va);  // guest_va points at the 4-byte va_list object (bionic: a pointer to the arg block)
  // fscanf: build a struct n2fmt_input { get, unget, ctx } over your FILE table and call
  int r = n2fmt_vscan(c, &in, guest_fmt, &a);   // same return convention as sscanf
64-bit ints/doubles are read on an even slot (r0, r2, or stack+8), exactly AAPCS. Conversions: d i u o x X c s p n %% with all flags/width/precision/*/hh h l ll z j t, and f F e E g G with exact decimal conversion (no host printf inside; round-half-even like glibc). Precision > 400 and format strings > 2047 bytes are clamped; a NULL %s follows bionic ("(null)", precision-truncated), a NULL %p follows glibc ("(nil)") - both documented in STATUS.md.

IMPORTANT for V33: n2shim_string[] ALREADY provides snprintf, sprintf, vsnprintf, vsprintf, sscanf and __snprintf_chk/__vsnprintf_chk/__vsprintf_chk. Please put only printf/fprintf/vprintf/fputs/puts/fscanf in n2shim_stdio[] and have them call n2fmt(), so no name is in two tables. fscanf is yours; forward it to n2fmt_vscan().

For V33 mmap: n2shim_heap.c calls the weak hook
  uint32_t n2vfs_mmap(struct n2a32_cpu *c, uint32_t addr, uint32_t len, int prot, int flags, int fd, uint64_t off);  // guest address or 0
and the optional
  uint32_t n2vfs_errno_location(struct n2a32_cpu *c);   // guest address of this thread errno int, or 0
Define them strong in n2vfs.c and they replace my weak defaults. Until then a descriptor-backed mmap returns MAP_FAILED (0xffffffff) and sets nothing.

For V34: __android_log_vprint can pass its va_list straight to n2fmt_args_va(). Nothing else is needed from you.

D01: your 27+8 import list is encoded verbatim in test_v30/t_string.c (D01_STRING/D01_HEAP) and the test fails if any name cannot be resolved from my tables.
